ROBOTS: TWO hosts are involved and BOTH were fetched FIRST, before any category request. (1) https://www.coincasa.it/robots.txt - HTTP 200, 122 bytes, verbatim and complete: 'User-agent: * / Disallow: /cart / Disallow: /login / Disallow: /account / Sitemap: https://www.coin.it/it-it/sitemap_index.xml'. (2) https://www.coin.it/robots.txt - HTTP 200, byte-identical content. NEITHER file names ClaudeBot, Claude-Web, anthropic-ai, Claude-User, Claude-SearchBot or any Claude agent at all, so no Claude-specific group exists and only the generic '*' group applies; it disallows exactly three paths (/cart, /login, /account), none of which was requested. No Crawl-delay is declared on either host; probe.py's 2 s per-host gap was honoured. ACCESS / HOST NOTE (important, flagged rather than glossed): www.coincasa.it serves the homepage (HTTP 200, 254 KB) and the full mega-menu, but EVERY category path under it returns HTTP 404 - /it-it/shop-casa/bagno/ and /it-it/shop-casa/bagno/accessori-bagno/ were each tried across the full 10-fingerprint rotation and with it-IT Accept-Language + Referer headers, always 404. The identical paths resolve 200 on www.coin.it, which is the same Salesforce Commerce Cloud instance (Sites-coin_eu-Site / it_IT): Coincasa is Coin's home banner and coincasa.it is a brand front-door onto the coin.it catalogue. Three independent pieces of evidence fix coin.it as the canonical listing host rather than a guess by me: (a) coincasa.it's OWN robots.txt declares 'Sitemap: https://www.coin.it/it-it/sitemap_index.xml'; (b) https://www.coincasa.it/it-it/sitemap_index.xml returns the same 430-byte index listing only coin.it locs; (c) every fetched listing page carries pointing at its coin.it self URL (e.g. canonical = https://www.coin.it/it-it/shop-casa/bagno/accessori-bagno/). The validated Furniture.xlsx pass for this same company (SR 122 Coincasa) also recorded coin.it URLs - dedup index entries include coin.it/it-it/shop-casa/mobili/tavoli and four siblings - so this run is consistent with it. No URL was invented: every link recorded or reviewed appears verbatim in coincasa.it's own mega-menu (as a relative path) AND in the coin.it category sitemap. TREE SOURCE: the site's own navigation, not guessed patterns. The complete mega-menu is server-rendered in the coincasa.it homepage HTML; 90 distinct /shop-casa/ links were extracted from it, giving the department set Bagno, Camera da letto, Cura/organizzazione/decorazione casa, Illuminazione interni, Mobili, Outdoor, Soggiorno, Tavola e Cucina, Tessili casa, plus the Aria di Bianco / Festa d'Estate / Editoriali campaign hubs. Cross-checked against https://www.coin.it/it-it/sitemap_0-category.xml (3,124 category URLs, reached from the robots-declared sitemap index). The Bagno department has exactly FIVE permanent children in both sources: Asciugamani, Accappatoi e ciabatte, Accessori bagno, Saponi e creme, Tappeti bagno. Accessori bagno was itself checked for a third level - its in-page category nav lists only its four siblings and its only refinements are price/colour facets - so it is a true leaf and is recorded at its own URL. QTY SOURCE: the listing page's own rendered total, N Prodotti, cross-checked against the page's own 'Hai visualizzato X di N prodotti' pagination line. VERIFICATION (1) three-way agreement on every node: header count, rendered .product-tile count, and - for the recorded leaf and two controls - a full enumeration. VERIFICATION (2) ENUMERATION TO EXHAUSTION via the storefront's OWN grid endpoint, the one the PLP itself renders from and links to in its 'show more' href: /on/demandware.store/Sites-coin_eu-Site/it_IT/Search-UpdateGrid?cgid=&start=N&sz=56 (not disallowed by robots - only /cart, /login, /account are). Paging it and collecting unique data-pid values gave: accessori-bagno 56 + 55 + 0 = 111 UNIQUE product ids, exactly matching the rendered header 111; tappeti-bagno 46 unique = header 46; specchi 7 unique = header 7. So the header is a genuine catalogue total, not a page-size artifact. was read and matched the node requested ('Accessori bagno', 'Tappeti bagno', 'Specchi', 'Cesti e organizer', ...). The assortment is soap dishes, soap dispensers, toothbrush holders, toilet-brush holders, bathroom bins (incl. pedal bins), bamboo and straw bathroom baskets, cotton-pad and cotton-bud holders, a 3-shelf bathroom unit, a bamboo bathroom cabinet, bathroom trays and a dressing mirror with tray - i.e. rules 13, 14, 17 and 12 all land on Bathroom. The Furniture.xlsx entries for Coincasa cover only /shop-casa/mobili/* and /shop-casa/outdoor/mobili-da-giardino, so nothing here collides and the single recorded row is genuinely new.
